from rdkit import Chem
import itertools

base = "COc1ccc(c3c1)c2c([nH]3)C3CC4C(C(=O)OC)C(OC)C(OC(=O)c5cc(OC)c(OC)c(OC)c5)CC4CN3CC2"

targets = {11:'R', 13:'S', 14:'S', 19:'R', 22:'R', 39:'S'}

# positions in SMILES of the 6 chiral atoms (in order 11,13,14,19,22,39 by atom idx)
# Build via template: replace C with [C@H] or [C@@H]
# SMILES tokens for chiral atoms in order of appearance:
# atom11 = "C3" (first aliphatic stereocenter) ; atom13 = the "C4" ; atom14="C(C(=O)OC)"; atom19="C(OC)"; atom22="C(OC(=O)..)"; atom39="C4" closing

def build(tags):
    t = list(tags)  # each '@' or '@@'
    s = f"COc1ccc(c3c1)c2c([nH]3)[C{t[0]}H]3C[C{t[1]}H]4[C{t[2]}H](C(=O)OC)[C{t[3]}H](OC)[C{t[4]}H](OC(=O)c5cc(OC)c(OC)c(OC)c5)C[C{t[5]}H]4CN3CC2"
    return s

for combo in itertools.product(['@','@@'], repeat=6):
    s = build(combo)
    m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(s)
    if m is None: 
        continue
    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, cleanIt=True, force=True)
    cip = {}
    ok = True
    for idx, want in targets.items():
        got = m.GetAtomWithIdx(idx).GetProp('_CIPCode') if m.GetAtomWithIdx(idx).HasProp('_CIPCode') else None
        if got != want:
            ok = False
            break
    if ok:
        print("FOUND:", combo)
        print(s)
        break
else:
    print("none found")
EOF

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, Draw

smi = "COc1ccc(c3c1)c2c([nH]3)[C@H]3C[C@@H]4[C@H](C(=O)OC)[C@@H](OC)[C@H](OC(=O)c5cc(OC)c(OC)c(OC)c5)C[C@@H]4CN3CC2"
m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
m = Chem.AddHs(m)

# Embed with ETKDGv3, several random seeds, keep best MMFF energy
best = None
for seed in range(42, 62):
    mh = Chem.Mol(m)
    params = AllChem.ETKDGv3()
    params.randomSeed = seed
    cid = AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh, params)
    if cid != 0:
        continue
    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh, maxIters=500)
    prop = AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mh, mmffVariant='MMFF94')
    e = AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(mh, prop).CalcEnergy()
    if best is None or e < best[0]:
        best = (e, seed, mh)
print("best MMFF energy:", best[0], "seed:", best[1])
mh = best[2]

# verify stereocenters kept in 3D: check via CIP on the 3D coords (chiral volume)
Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(mh)
for idx in [11,13,14,19,22,39]:
    a = mh.GetAtomWithIdx(idx)
    print(idx, a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '?')

Chem.MolToXYZFile(mh, 'mmff.xyz')
